Name: Startup Volume Config
Author: certifiableGrimalkin
Description:
I was extremely tired of the loud, blaring sounds Stardew was emitting, every time I opened the game.
On first use, it just mutes the sounds and creates the config file.
You can then set the volumes, as a number between 0.0 and 1.0, in the config.json in the mod folder, or just use the menu in GMCM, if you have it installed.
The volumes will take effect on the next game launch.

MusicVolume - Volume of the music in the main menu.
SoundVolume - Button click sounds.
AmbientVolume - Nature noises.
FootstepVolume - Button hover sounds.

Now works with Game Launch and Returning to the Main Menu.

This mod does not change the volumes on save load. Your saves will have the volumes you set in them, as in vanilla.

Downloads.Description: Music Volume on Mute Toggle will now change to what the Music Volume setting in the config is, on Game Launch. To have the change happen, restart the game.
